Do not repeat the forward exposed tread face or draw a top view. 2. True below-camera underside of the complete L-shaped paving tile: opaque pale cracked flagstone/stone substrate spanning the full plan footprint, with dark grout and only actual outer border overhang; no raised L curb or top-facing pavers visible. 3. Strict principal-axis camera, no perspective or isometric angle, no shadows or glow, crisp pixel art. Hidden construction may be inferred conservatively; preserve source-supported geometry and material.
